definitions.ask: Should `just install` create the "Bob Mac Capture Local" signing identity itself when the login keychain lacks it?

choices.label: The first GUI-Terminal install creates it unattended, so install-all needs no manual setup
Installs never touch the keychain; Bryan runs `just signing-identity` once by hand

definitions.why: the manual Keychain Access step never happened, and every ad-hoc install breaks Tabs again
